prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production albedo texture for the rebuilt market stall in a faithful Jak 3 remaster. Input image 1 is the original 64 x 32 city-slum-wood-plain texture extracted from the user's game, and is the EDIT TARGET / strict palette and grain-direction reference. Reconstruct this same weathered desert wood material in crisp high definition, as a wide 2:1 image, ideally 2048 x 1024 pixels. Preserve its subdued warm olive-brown / sand-grey palette (representative average RGB about 127,119,89), overall middle value, horizontally flowing broad grain and gentle irregular wood fibres. Keep the identity of the original Jak material. Add genuinely resolved fine woody fibres, natural wavering grain, shallow dry grain grooves, small worn pores and a few subtle fine splits, with richer believable surface detail and clean readable stylized-realistic art appropriate to Jak's animated world. This is only a continuous wood surface material used on a modeled object, not a photograph of a board or a scene. Fill every pixel to all four edges with the material, flat front-on orthographic crop, evenly lit diffuse albedo without directional light, cast shadows, specular highlights or baked ambient shading. Make it seamlessly tileable horizontally and vertically as far as possible: grain should continue through opposite boundaries, no framing seam. Do not add individual planks, joins, board boundaries, checker grids, masonry, tiles, hardware, nails, objects, foliage, letters, a border, a background, or perspective. Do not turn it orange, red, dark chocolate, bright yellow, bleached white or grey stone. The visual upgrade must come from more convincing high-resolution wood detail, while the original muted colour and horizontal grain remain recognizably faithful.
postprocessing: Byte-for-byte copy of the built-in generated PNG; no pixel editing, cropping, resizing or colour changes.

validation.grain: Horizontal irregular dry wood grain matching the reference's coarse flow.
validation.palette: Muted olive-brown/sand-grey, close to the original average RGB.
validation.tiling: Opposite-edge continuity requested; exact pixel-perfect wrap is not guaranteed. Edge measurements in wood-image-metrics.json.
validation.integration: Asset only. GLB, model files, native data and runtime were not modified.
